promise: Constitutional ban on re-election of any popularly elected office, promised to take effect in 2027
description: The anti-re-election rule was published 1 Apr 2025, but its implementation was postponed from 2027 to 2030.

promise: Defeat inflation ('kill inflation', the overriding goal of his first year)
description: Annual inflation fell from 211.4% (2023) and 254.2% (first month) to 117.8% (2024) and ~31.8% by Sept 2025, with monthly inflation at a five-year low of 1.5% (June 2025) — a huge reduction, though inflation was not eliminated.

promise: Increase defence spending to 2.5% of GDP
description: The 2.5%-by-2027 pledge was confirmed, funded by cutting international aid from 0.5% to 0.3% of GNI.

promise: Restore sound public finances / keep the deficit on a path toward the EU's 3% of GDP ceiling
description: The deficit was 5.8% of GDP in 2024 (up from 5.4% in 2023 and at risk of exceeding 6%), public debt reached 116.5% of GDP in 2025, and the 3% target is far out of reach.

promise: xAI would expand the Colossus supercomputer to 1 million GPUs (a tenfold increase)
description: Three months after the first 100,000 H100s came online at Colossus (built in 122 days, Sept 2024), xAI announced the 30-acre Memphis expansion toward 1 million GPUs, reported by the FT as 'Musk plans to expand Colossus tenfold'. Growth is ongoing (200k GPUs by late 2024; ~230k by June 2025) but the 1M milestone had not been publicly confirmed as of mid-2026.
evidence: Colossus built in 122 days with 100k H100s (Wikipedia: Colossus)
FT (Dec 4, 2024): plans to expand Colossus tenfold to ~1M GPUs
By June 2025: 150k H100s + 50k H200s + 30k GB200s, more planned

promise: Nvidia expects to sell $1 trillion of AI hardware through 2027
description: At GTC 2026 Huang forecast NVIDIA would sell ~$1 trillion in AI hardware by the end of 2027 (per Tom's Hardware, Mar 16, 2026), building on a $500B order book (Nov 2025) and 'trillions more' infrastructure claims. Hard revenue promise with a 2027 deadline, still pending as of mid-2026.
evidence: Tom's Hardware (Mar 16, 2026): 'Jensen Huang expects Nvidia to sell $1 trillion of AI hardware through 2027'
GTC 2026 keynote: 'By 2027, market demand will exceed $1 trillion' (WEEX transcript)

promise: Make Europe independent from Russian fossil fuels, ending reliance on Russian gas by 2027
description: The European Commission's REPowerEU plan, presented in May 2022 after Russia's invasion of Ukraine, set the goal of ending the EU's dependence on Russian fossil fuels, including a full phase-out of Russian gas, well before 2030 and by 2027 at the latest. The EU cut Russian gas imports by roughly 75% between 2021 and 2025, and in January 2026 adopted legislation banning Russian LNG imports from the start of 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027.
evidence: Russian gas imports cut by about 75% between 2021 and 2025
EU regulation banning Russian LNG from January 2027 and pipeline gas from autumn 2027 approved in January 2026
National phase-out plans were due to the Commission by 1 March 2026
sources: PubAffairs Bruxelles / Council of the EU

promise: Deliver equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027
description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino said in 2023 that FIFA's goal was equal prize money for the men's and women's World Cups by 2027, a pledge widely reported at the 2023 Women's World Cup. FIFA announced a record $655 million prize pool for the 2026 men's World Cup (up from $440 million in 2022) and has stated its intent to reach parity for the 2027 Women's World Cup, which remains forthcoming.
evidence: 2026 men's prize pool is a record $655m, nearly six times the 2023 women's $110m pool
US men's and women's teams agreed to share 80% of 2026/2027 prize earnings equally
